Shipping Policy

Effective Date: January 1, 2025

Store Name: Jia Express

Destination: All Over India


At Jia Express, we partner with reliable domestic courier companies and speed post to deliver your products safely.


1. Order Processing & Handling Time

  • Orders are typically processed and handed over to the courier within 1 to 2 business days from the date of order confirmation and payment.

2. Transit & Delivery Time

  • Standard delivery across India takes approximately 7 to 8 business days from the date of dispatch.
  • Note: Delivery times may occasionally vary due to local public holidays, unforeseen logistics bottlenecks, or remote postal locations.

3. Shipping Rates

We offer transparent shipping tiers based on order value and package weight:

  • Orders Above ₹199: Free Shipping (Any Weight)
  • Orders Below ₹200:
    • 0 – 500g: ₹40
    • 501 – 1000g: ₹70
    • 1001 – 2000g: ₹90
    • 2001 – 3000g: ₹100
    • 3001 – 4000g: ₹120
    • 4001 – 5000g: ₹140
    • 5001 – 10000g: ₹200
    • 10001 – 20000g: ₹300
    • 20001 – 30000g: ₹500
    • 30001g or Above: ₹800

4. Shipment Tracking

Once your order has been dispatched, you will receive a tracking link via email or SMS so you can monitor your shipment's progress.


Contact Us

For any questions about this policy or to start a refund request, visit our Contact Us page and we'll be happy to help.
